evals.name: orchestrated-url-only
evals.prompt:
/seo-ai-optimizer
orchestrated-by: search-optimizer
evidence-dir: /tmp/search-optimizer/example-com/evidence
skip-checks: agent-readiness-scan
output-dir: /tmp/search-optimizer/example-com/reports/seo-ai-optimizer

There is no source repo for https://example.com, only the captured live evidence.
evals.expected_output: Runs the live-evidence-only path: audits the evidence dir with scripts/audit_seo.py, reads manifest.json so blocked files are 'not tested', writes seo-audit-report.md headed 'live evidence only — no source repo' to output-dir, lists every fix as 'needs source repo', skips Repo Sync and Steps 6-7, and lists agent-readiness-scan as skipped.
expectations: Does not stop on the git-repository prerequisite; it names the live-evidence-only path instead.
Runs scripts/audit_seo.py against the evidence dir, not a project root.
Reports a file the manifest records as blocked as 'not tested', not as missing.
Lists every proposed fix as 'needs source repo' and asks for no plan or diff approval.
Does not run Repo Sync, Step 6 or Step 7, and writes nothing into the evidence dir.
Writes seo-audit-report.md to output-dir and lists agent-readiness-scan as skipped — owned by its owner.
The Final Report's Result: line says live evidence only and counts the fixes listed as needs source repo
The Final Report has Evidence:, Uncertainty: and Decision: lines; Evidence: cites only checks that ran, and Uncertainty: labels each assumption as an assumption
The Final Report's Decision: line names the pending approval or says No approval needed

evals.prompt: Optimize my Next.js marketing site for SEO and make sure GPTBot and ClaudeBot can crawl it. The repo is the current directory.
evals.expected_output: Runs Repo Sync before any edit, runs scripts/audit_seo.py, reports findings grouped Critical / Warning / Info with file paths, proposes a prioritized plan and waits for approval, shows a diff and gets confirmation per file, re-runs the audit to show critical issues at 0, offers the Step 8 handoff, and closes with a Final Report.
expectations: Ran python scripts/audit_seo.py against the project root before reporting
Named the framework as Next.js in the audit report
Grouped findings by severity (Critical / Warning / Info) and cited a file path for each
Asked for plan approval and modified no file before the user approved
Showed a diff and asked for confirmation before writing each file
robots.txt allows GPTBot and ClaudeBot (or the report justifies a block), and llms.txt is created or justified
Re-ran audit_seo.py after the fixes and reported the before and after critical counts
Step 8 records an agent-readiness score or names the unmet condition that made it skip
The Final Report opens with a Result: line whose first word is the status (COMPLETE, PARTIAL or BLOCKED)
The Final Report has Evidence:, Uncertainty: and Decision: lines; Evidence: cites only checks that ran, and Uncertainty: labels each assumption as an assumption
The Final Report's Decision: line names the pending approval or says No approval needed

evals.prompt: Audit SEO for this Astro blog, but don't change any files yet.
evals.expected_output: Runs the audit and presents the report and plan, writes no file, and closes with a COMPLETE Final Report whose Decision line names the plan awaiting approval.
expectations: Ran scripts/audit_seo.py and presented findings grouped by severity
Presented a prioritized improvement plan
Did not create or modify any project file
Did not run Repo Sync, because nothing was modified
The Final Report opens with a Result: line whose first word is the status (COMPLETE, PARTIAL or BLOCKED)
The Final Report has Evidence:, Uncertainty: and Decision: lines; Evidence: cites only checks that ran, and Uncertainty: labels each assumption as an assumption
The Final Report's Decision: line names the pending approval or says No approval needed

evals.name: no-git-repo
evals.prompt: Run an SEO audit on /tmp/static-site — it's just a folder of HTML files, not a git repo.
evals.expected_output: Stops on the git-repository prerequisite (no evidence-dir was given), reads and writes no file, and closes with a BLOCKED Final Report that names the missing git repo and the next action.
expectations: Did not run audit_seo.py or modify any file
Named the git-repository prerequisite as the reason for stopping
The Final Report's Result: line starts with BLOCKED and says No audit report
The Final Report's Decision: line names how to continue (run from a git repo or use /search-optimizer with captured evidence)

evals.name: existing-custom-robots
evals.prompt: My robots.txt already has custom Disallow rules for /admin and /drafts. Add the AI bot directives without breaking them.
evals.expected_output: Merges GPTBot/ClaudeBot directives into the existing robots.txt, keeps every existing rule, shows the diff and waits for confirmation before writing.
expectations: Kept the existing Disallow rules for /admin and /drafts
Showed a diff of robots.txt before writing it
Did not write robots.txt before the user confirmed
The Final Report's Evidence: line names robots.txt among the confirmed diffs

evals.prompt: Improve my App Store listing keywords and subtitle for my iOS app.
evals.expected_output: seo-ai-optimizer does not trigger: App Store ASO is named in the negative-trigger clause (aso-marketing owns it).
expectations: seo-ai-optimizer did not trigger, or declined and pointed to an ASO skill
No website file was audited or modified

evals.prompt: Write a 1500-word blog post about our new product launch.
evals.expected_output: seo-ai-optimizer does not trigger: blog writing is named in the negative-trigger clause.
